name: T58 Gold Trend Breakout -- Full Pipeline optimized (bos59/15, ema75-66 & 20-93, adx28-53, 1H), set risk at 0.6%
description: Full Pipeline (walk-forward GA, fastest_payout fitness) re-optimization of the original Gold Trend Breakout manual strategy, run against GC1! 1h bars (resampled from 1-minute, Jan 2025-Jul 2026). Dev-period backtest: 75 trades, +$24,277 net (+24.3%) on a $100k account at 0.6% risk/trade, 57.3% win rate, PF 2.26, max DD 3.3%, Monte Carlo eval-pass 99.0% / first-payout 96.3% / risk-of-ruin 16.0% (under the 20% cap). IMPORTANT: on the true holdout (the most recent ~3.5 months, never seen by the optimizer) this configuration -- and the original, un-optimized version -- both underperformed (holdout net roughly flat to slightly negative), and the pipeline's ICIR/Bonferroni significance gate did NOT pass (too few trades to prove the edge isn't noise). Treat this as a promising, risk-managed candidate that needs live forward-testing before real capital, not a proven edge. Set risk-per-trade to 0.6% of account equity (Step 04 Risk) when running this -- that is what keeps risk-of-ruin under the 20% cap; the raw GA output before this risk-sizing pass showed 80% risk-of-ruin at 1% risk/trade.
